messages:
Maria R.: Quick summary and next steps — incident started 2026-03-14 23:12 UTC, root cause was a cert rotation job that briefly removed token validation from the routing service, ~27m of elevated 500s for hosted inference. Customer-facing bridges were opened for affected accounts; bridge closed at 23:50 UTC. No data loss reported. Need: postmortem scheduling, customer comms, and assignment of remediation tasks. @Evan can you confirm mitigation timeline?

SRE-Bot: Incident: INC-20260314-1423 ended. Severity: Sev2 -> mitigated. Paging log: auto-paged oncall at 23:13 UTC, auto-closed at 23:51 UTC.

Evan (oncall): I paged at 23:13, verified high 5xx from routing-prod-1/2. Rolled back the cert-rotate cron at 23:22 which removed the bad validation layer. Traffic normalized ~23:35 after rolling restart of the routing pool to clear cached cert state; final checks done by 23:48. During mitigation we had a fallback route to smaller gpu-pool but it hit capacity quickly.

Lina S.: Thanks Evan. Two immediate asks: 1) schedule the postmortem sync, 2) draft status page update and customer email. Proposed postmortem times: Mon 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC or Tue 2026-03-17 14:00 UTC. Which works for folks?

Priya - Cust Success: I'll be looped in for customer comms. We need an internal exec summary + a technical appendix. Customers want: timeline, impact, mitigation, and next steps (what we changed and when we'll prevent recurrence). Prefer the RCA share sometime Tue/Thu next week.

Ops Lead - Rafael: +1 to Tue 14:00 UTC for PM/Ops + Eng. I'll own the remediation tracking board.

Maria R.: Tue 2026-03-17 14:00 UTC it is then. Lina, please create a calendar invite and attach a short agenda: (1) timeline + logs, (2) root cause analysis, (3) action items + owners, (4) customer message draft review.

Evan (oncall): Adding notes I captured:
```
23:12 UTC - first spike 500s on routing Prod
23:13 UTC - oncall alert, started triage
23:20 UTC - identified new cert-rotation job push at 22:58 UTC that removed token validation header
23:22 UTC - disabled cert-rotate cron (rollback)
23:27 UTC - routing pool 1 restart attempt - partial success
23:35 UTC - traffic shifted back to healthy backends
23:48 UTC - sanity checks, cache flush on edge
23:50 UTC - bridge closed
```
Will upload full logs to the incident folder.

Lina S.: Draft status page blurb for ops review (Priya, Rafael, Maria — feel free to edit):
```
[Resolved] 2026-03-14 23:50 UTC — We experienced an elevated error rate for the Redwood Hosted Inference API caused by a misconfigured background cert rotation job. We mitigated the issue by rolling back the job and restarting affected routing instances. Impact: increased 500 errors for ~27 minutes for a subset of customers. No data loss. Full RCA will be published after internal review.
```
Please suggest wording if too technical.

Priya - Cust Success: That blurb looks fine. For customer emails we should add concrete next steps and timeline commitments: when RCA will be shared and what short-term and long-term fixes we'll do. Draft I can send once we have the action list.

Maria R.: Action items I'm capturing now. Rafael will track them in the remediation board. Please react with :white_check_mark: if you accept ownership or reply with alternate owner.
1) Create incident timeline and attach logs (owner: Evan) — due Thu 2026-03-19 17:00 UTC.
2) Write root cause analysis draft (owner: Lina + Evan) — due Mon 2026-03-16 20:00 UTC.
3) Build permanent guardrails for cert-rotation job (owner: Eng Runtime - Rafael) — due Fri 2026-03-27 EOD.
4) Add automated pre-release validation to CI for rotation jobs (owner: Eng-Infra - TBD) — due Fri 2026-03-27.
5) Customer-facing email draft + release schedule (owner: Priya) — due Tue 2026-03-17 18:00 UTC.
6) Update status page and post incident note (owner: Lina) — due Tue 2026-03-17 19:00 UTC.
7) Runbook update: token validation verification step (owner: Evan) — due Mon 2026-03-23.

Evan (oncall): I'll take item 1 and 7. :white_check_mark:

Ops Lead - Rafael: I'll take item 3 and own tracking. I'll assign Eng-Infra for item 4 after the postmortem.

Priya - Cust Success: I'll draft the customer email. Rough draft below — please comment on tone and tech accuracy: 

"Hi [Customer],

We experienced an interruption to the Redwood Hosted Inference API on 14 Mar 2026 between 23:12 and 23:50 UTC which caused some requests to return errors. Our engineering team rolled back a configuration job and restarted affected services; traffic returned to normal at 23:35 UTC and the incident was closed at 23:50 UTC. We are currently completing an internal review and will share a detailed RCA by Tue 17 Mar 2026. We apologize for the impact and are taking steps to prevent recurrence, including improved CI validation and automated pre-deploy checks for cert rotation jobs.

If you'd like a direct briefing, let us know and we can set up a call.

Best,
Priya on behalf of Redwood Support"

Lina S.: That reads well. Suggest we add a short bulleted list of short-term mitigations we already did: rollback, instance restarts, cache flush. And commit to a timeline for the permanent fix (Rafael's sprint target).

Maria R.: Good. Two more logistics items:
- We should redact low-level logs before sharing with external customers (sensitive tokens). Evan, can you produce a redacted log bundle by Thu?
- Postmortem reviewer list: Eng Runtime, Eng-Infra, Ops, Cust Success. Add PM from affected product.

Evan (oncall): I'll prepare the redacted bundle. ETA Thu 2026-03-19 17:00 UTC for upload.

Ops Lead - Rafael: For the remediation board I'll create columns: Backlog, In Progress, QA, Done. I'll add tasks and owners today and send link after I finish.

SRE-Bot: Reminder: Postmortem meeting scheduled Tue 2026-03-17 14:00 UTC. Calendar invite created by Lina S.

Priya - Cust Success: One ask from customers: can we confirm a more specific SLA impact note? E.g., which customers saw errors and approximate percent of requests per affected account. Evan, can you pull per-customer error counts?

Evan (oncall): Yes, I'll add a per-customer error breakdown to the timeline doc.

Maria R.: Final checklist before we close this thread:
- [ ] Postmortem meeting Tue 14:00 UTC (calendar invite) — Lina
- [ ] RCA draft — Lina/Evan
- [ ] Redacted logs for customer share — Evan
- [ ] Status page update — Lina (post-meeting)
- [ ] Customer email sent — Priya (post-meeting)
- [ ] Remediation board live — Rafael

Please update this thread when tasks are complete. I'll follow up after the postmortem with an exec summary for GTM/CS. Thanks everyone for the quick response and thorough notes. :wave:

Lina S.: I'll post the invite and attach an initial timeline export.

Priya - Cust Success: I'll prep the customer list and target distribution after the meeting.

Evan (oncall): Uploaded timeline + logs link: https://redwood.internal/incident/2109876543/timeline (redacted version will be posted to the same path).

Maria R.: Closing the operational bridge — we'll reconvene at the postmortem. If anything changes ping here or escalate to the oncall.

(End of thread)
